title: China’s Embassy in Mexico Urges US to Acknowledge Its Failures and Adopt Anti-Fentanyl Policies
author: La Jornada Editorial Staff
content:
_This article by[La Jornada Editorial
Staff](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/La) originally appeared in the
[November 22, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/22/politica/embajada-de-
china-en-mexico-pide-a-eu-asumir-fallas-y-aplicar-politicas-contra-el-
fentanilo), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City.** Amid the public accusations exchanged in recent days by the
US and Chinese diplomatic missions in Mexico, **China’s embassy** in the
country urged its counterpart to “acknowledge its own domestic failures and
implement viable governance policies” to address the problems it faces
concerning fentanyl.

On its social media accounts, the Asian country’s mission in Mexico said the
US diplomatic mission “should appreciate the **humanitarian aid** it receives
from nations such as China and Mexico, and strengthen existing cooperation,
instead of continuing to blame others.”

> [Post by @EmbChinaMex on
> X](https://x.com/EmbChinaMex/status/2124673392590602534)

It expressed hope that “the US embassy understands that seeking external
solutions to domestic problems is useless. If they fail to find the right
direction and attitude” and lamented that the US mission in Mexico has been
working “harder lately, because on days off it shared a media article
published eight days earlier and made an effort to trumpet it.”

> It maintained that “diligent work, above all **respecting the sovereignty**
> and concerns of the host country and promoting bilateral and multilateral
> cooperation, is the basic obligation of every diplomatic mission. But it is
> essential that these institutions have the right direction and maintain an
> appropriate attitude.”
